foundation.title: Turn what you know into what you can say.
foundation.description: A focused English interview practice loop built around retrieval, transfer, and evidence of real progress.
foundation.actionHint: Foundation is ready for the first learning-loop slice.
foundation.statusOffline: API is offline. Start the backend to connect this screen.

courseCoreStageOne.title: Practice on your terms.
courseCoreStageOne.description: Sign in without onboarding, voice calibration, or a daily plan. Course Core features will appear here only after their release gates pass.
courseCoreStageOne.confirmationSent: Check your email to confirm the account, then sign in.
courseCoreStageOne.signedInCopy: The Legacy learning loop is no longer active. Your old learning records remain preserved and unchanged while Course Core is enabled in stages.
courseCoreStageOne.status: Course Core is at its safe transition checkpoint.

courseCore.homeTitle: Choose what you want to practice.
courseCore.homeDescription: Open any course and explore its fixed interview questions. There are no daily plans, locks, completion states, or required setup steps.
courseCore.coursesDescription: Browse 30 fixed interview courses and choose any question in your own order.
courseCore.practiceDescription: Run a focused multi-question practice session when Practice V2 is released.
courseCore.aboutMeDescription: Add the real background information FluentLoop may use for future personalization.
courseCore.catalogDescription: Thirty courses, fifty-nine fixed questions, and no prescribed sequence. Pick the topic that matters now.
courseCore.catalogError: The Course Catalog is unavailable right now.
courseCore.courseNotFound: This course does not exist in course_catalog_v1.
courseCore.featureGateDescription: This entry is part of the new App Shell but remains disabled until its own implementation stage passes review.
courseCore.chineseGuide: Say only what you actually did in Chinese. After recording, review the original Chinese and organized English together. Nothing enters History or Memory until you confirm. Uploaded drafts can be recovered after refresh.
courseCore.draftNotSaved: Draft awaiting your confirmation — not saved to History
courseCore.confirmDraftHelp: Check that the English is faithful to what you said. Confirm to save; otherwise discard or answer again. No English re-recording is required.
courseCore.confirmDraftError: Could not confirm this draft. It remains recoverable; retry or refresh to check its state.
courseCore.discardDraftConfirm: Discard this unconfirmed draft and its recording? It will not enter History or Memory.
courseCore.discardDraftError: Draft could not be discarded. Please retry.
courseCore.recoverDraft: You have an uploaded Chinese draft for this question.
courseCore.draftRestoreError: Could not load pending drafts. Refresh before creating another answer if an upload was interrupted.
courseCore.processing: Saving the original audio and creating the final transcript…
courseCore.supportError: This support panel is temporarily unavailable. Your answer state has not changed.
courseCore.feedbackPending: Feedback is being prepared. Your answer is already safely saved.
courseCore.feedbackFailed: Feedback could not be generated. Your saved answer is unchanged.
courseCore.noHistory: No saved answers for this question yet.
courseCore.failure: The audio was saved, but processing did not finish.
courseCore.failureExpires: Failed audio is retained for three days for retry.
courseCore.micError: Microphone access is required to record an answer.
courseCore.ttsError: Question audio is unavailable. You can still read the question and record.
courseCore.uploadError: The answer could not be completed. Retry uses the same request and will not duplicate it.
courseCore.historyError: Answer History is unavailable right now.
courseCore.leaveBlocked: Finish or discard the recording before changing the question or leaving.
courseCore.discardConfirm: Discard this recording? It will not be saved.
courseCore.deleteAnswerConfirm: Delete this Answer, its transcript, audio, and related Memory sources?
courseCore.deleteAnswerError: The Answer could not be deleted.

aboutMePage.title: Your facts, under your control.
aboutMePage.description: Add only real background information. About Me is optional and never blocks a Course.
aboutMePage.loadError: About Me is unavailable right now.
aboutMePage.saveError: The change could not be saved.
aboutMePage.rolesHelp: Keep more than one role when your search spans different directions.
aboutMePage.resumesHelp: Each PDF remains an independent private source.
aboutMePage.factsHelp: One truthful fact per line. You can revise or remove these at any time.
aboutMePage.memoriesHelp: Durable facts saved only from validated sources. You can delete any Memory.
aboutMePage.emptyMemories: No validated Memory yet. Courses still work normally.
aboutMePage.deleteConfirm: Delete this item? Related source links will also be removed.

calibration.readyCopy: Next, answer three short questions so FluentLoop can establish a provisional speaking baseline.
calibration.question: Question
calibration.processing: Saving your recording, then transcribing and analyzing it…
calibration.readOnly: Calibration transcripts are read-only so the baseline reflects your original spoken answer.
calibration.noCorrection: Answer naturally. FluentLoop will not interrupt or correct you mid-answer.
calibration.evolves: This profile is an initial observation, not a permanent score. It will evolve with evidence from later training.
calibration.ttsFallback: Audio is unavailable; read the visible question and continue.
calibration.micError: Microphone access is required to record an answer.

onboarding.promise: Turn what you know into what you can say.
onboarding.intro: Build a verified profile so every practice session can stay relevant to your real experience.
onboarding.confirmationSent: Check your email to confirm the account, then sign in.
onboarding.sourceIntro: Upload a text-based PDF or paste your background. You will review everything before it becomes part of your profile.
onboarding.backgroundPlaceholder: Paste your experience, projects, education, and skills…
onboarding.reviewIntro: Edit, add, or remove anything. Only confirmed fields become durable profile facts.
onboarding.storyWarning: Suggestions only — they are not stored as confirmed facts.
onboarding.completeCopy: FluentLoop can now personalize later practice using facts you reviewed and confirmed.

entry.error: Unable to load your learning space.

today.title: Turn what you know into what you can say.
today.copy: A short, guided practice built around your confirmed profile.
today.voiceInstruction: Listen if helpful, then answer aloud. Continue unlocks after your recording is saved, transcribed, and analyzed.
today.processing: Saving, transcribing, and analyzing your answer…
today.audioFallback: Audio is unavailable; read the visible prompt and continue.
today.micError: Microphone access is required to record this step.
today.error: Your progress could not be saved.

practice.title: Practice with purpose.
practice.copy: Review what is due, then try one complete interview answer without interruption.
practice.reviewCopy: One due expression is waiting in a hidden retrieval prompt.
practice.reviewPlaceholder: Answer without looking up the expression…
practice.noDue: No expressions are due right now.
practice.unavailable: Practice data is unavailable right now.

journey.title: Your 30-day path.
journey.copy: A steady progression from building language to transferring it, then performing under interview conditions.
journey.phaseDescription: Each phase keeps the same learning loop while gradually reducing scaffolding.
journey.signin: Sign in through Today to see your personal journey.

myEnglish.title: Your usable language.
myEnglish.copy: A calm view of what you are building: expressions, patterns, and confirmed stories.
myEnglish.unavailable: My English is unavailable right now.
myEnglish.signin: Sign in through Today to see your personal learning memory.
myEnglish.expressionEmpty: Expressions you learn and retrieve will appear here.
myEnglish.patternEmpty: Patterns are added only after repeated evidence.
myEnglish.storyEmpty: Only stories you confirm are saved here.

practiceV2.title: A round of real speaking practice
practiceV2.description: Choose 3 or 5 random questions. Speak without hints and get one report at the end.
practiceV2.scoreNotice: This encouragement score does not measure objective English ability, formal assessment results or interview pass probability.
practiceV2.noHistory: This report is available on this page only. Completed interviews have no history.
practiceV2.retention: In-progress interviews expire 24 hours after creation. Ending or abandoning deletes temporary answers and queues audio cleanup.
practiceV2.question: Question
practiceV2.paused: Interview paused. Your uploaded answers are retained until expiry.
practiceV2.saved: Answer saved for this interview. Choose what to do next.
practiceV2.answerFailed: No usable transcript was produced. Your recording is retained until this interview expires; retry processing or record again.
practiceV2.abandonConfirm: Abandon this interview and delete its temporary answers?
practiceV2.leaveBlocked: End or discard the recording before leaving.
practiceV2.audioError: Audio could not play. You can still record an answer.
practiceV2.micError: Microphone unavailable. Check microphone permissions and try again.
